biography.plain_text: Marco Bartolomeo Malgara is an Italian boatbuilder, competitive sailor and founder and chief executive of ICE Yachts. Based in Salvirola, his company produces semi-custom performance sailboats for an international clientele. Malgara combines ownership and product leadership with year-round sailing, using regular competition and personal testing to shape the yard’s approach to handling, equipment and design.

long_biography.plain_text:
Marco Malgara turned a search for a particular performance sailboat into a manufacturing business. Unable to find a used Felci 61, he leased the operations of its Salvirola builder, commissioned a substantially revised version and went on to acquire the yard. That decision became the foundation of ICE Yachts in 2012.

Malgara retained specialist workers from the former CN Yacht 2000 operation and rebuilt production around Italian manufacture, composite technology and close design collaboration. The yard keeps structural work and interiors under direct control, allowing it to adjust weight, materials and layouts for individual customers. He remains the company’s sole administrator and directs a range spanning fast cruising boats and performance-focused designs.
